hideLabel.name: Hide Label
hideLabel.description: Specify whether you want the underlying label to be visually hidden

minLabel.name: Min Label
minLabel.description: The label associated with the minimum value.

maxLabel.name: Max Label
maxLabel.description: The label associated with the maximum value.

value.name: Value
value.description: The value of the slider. When there are two handles, value is the lower bound.

step.name: Step
step.description: How much the value should increase/decrease by moving the thumb by mouse.

stepMultiplier.name: Step Multiplier
stepMultiplier.description: How much the value changes with Shift+arrow keys.

hideTextInput.name: Hide Text Input
hideTextInput.description: true to hide the number input box.

invalidText.name: Invalid Text
invalidText.description: Text displayed when the Slider is in an invalid state

warnText.name: Warn Text
warnText.description: Text displayed when the Slider is in a warning state.
